Acorn.name: Acorns
Acorn.desc: Plant them to grow an oak tree.

AncientCoin.name: Ancient Coin
AncientCoin.desc: A relic of a lost age. Its surface still bears the trace of mysterious symbols.

AncientGemstoneBlack.name: Draumyx
AncientGemstoneBlack.desc: A dark, opaque gem with a smooth and polished surface.

AncientGemstoneGreen.name: Grimvarn
AncientGemstoneGreen.desc: A striking green gem, the colour reminiscent of deep forests.

AncientGemstoneOrange.name: Solryth
AncientGemstoneOrange.desc: A vibrant orange stone, like a summer sunset.

AncientGemstonePurple.name: Veydris
AncientGemstonePurple.desc: A rich purple stone, suitable for royalty.

AncientSeed.name: Ancient Seed
AncientSeed.desc: Held against your ear, you hear tiny whisperings within...

ArmorAshlandsMediumChest.name: Breastplate of Ask
ArmorAshlandsMediumChest.desc: The first man in Midgard knew how to guard his most vital organs, perhaps with a breastplate just like this one.

ArmorAshlandsMediumlegs.name: Trousers of Ask
ArmorAshlandsMediumlegs.desc: The first man to roam Midgard preferred to tread lightly. Wearers of these trousers could learn a thing or two from him.

ArmorBerserkerChest.name: Patterns of the Bear
ArmorBerserkerChest.desc: If these intricate designs can protect warriors from distant lands, they can surely protect you too.

ArmorBerserkerLegs.name: Loincloth of the Bear
ArmorBerserkerLegs.desc: It covers all the important bits, but not much else.

ArmorBerserkerUndeadChest.name: Vilebone Cage
ArmorBerserkerUndeadChest.desc: Crafted from the shattered bones of a tormented bear.

ArmorBerserkerUndeadLegs.name: Vilebone Drapes
ArmorBerserkerUndeadLegs.desc: Thick hides and bone fragments woven into a rugged skirt.

ArmorBronzeLegs.name: Bronze Plate Leggings
ArmorBronzeLegs.desc: Bronze greaves to shield your legs.

ArmorCarapaceChest.name: Carapace Breastplate
ArmorCarapaceChest.desc: A breastplate crafted from the burnished carapace of a giant insect.

ArmorCarapaceLegs.name: Carapace Greaves
ArmorCarapaceLegs.desc: Leg guards of a rigid carapace.

ArmorDeepNorthHeavyChest.name: Breastplate of the Protector
ArmorDeepNorthHeavyChest.desc: Fur and hide and metal all work in tandem to ward off an enemy's blows.

ArmorDeepNorthHeavylegs.name: Trousers of the Protector
ArmorDeepNorthHeavylegs.desc: Heavy boots and trousers, to keep you warm as you trudge through deep snow.

ArmorDeepNorthMageChest.name: Robes of the Caller
ArmorDeepNorthMageChest.desc: Gold trimmed robes, fit for only the most powerful of mages.

ArmorDeepNorthMagelegs.name: Trousers of the Caller
ArmorDeepNorthMagelegs.desc: Tight legwraps to keep the cold from touching your skin.

ArmorDeepNorthMediumChest.name: Chestpiece of the Vanguard
ArmorDeepNorthMediumChest.desc: Expertly crafted leather armour, offering excellent protection without limiting a warrior's movements.

ArmorDeepNorthMediumlegs.name: Trousers of the Vanguard
ArmorDeepNorthMediumlegs.desc: Warm trousers suitable for a cold climate. The boots offer excellent grip in the icy terrain.

ArmorDress1.name: Plain Brown Dress
ArmorDress1.desc: A plain brown dress, worn over a blue underdress.

ArmorDress10.name: Simple Undyed Dress
ArmorDress10.desc: A simple dress for everyday wear.

ArmorDress2.name: Brown Dress with Shawl
ArmorDress2.desc: A brown dress, with a matching shawl around the shoulders. Warm and stylish!

ArmorDress3.name: Brown Dress with Beads
ArmorDress3.desc: A fancy brown dress, with beads and silver fibula brooches. Excellent for a feast!

ArmorDress4.name: Plain Blue Dress
ArmorDress4.desc: A plain blue dress, worn over a red underdress.

ArmorDress5.name: Blue Dress with Shawl
ArmorDress5.desc: A blue dress, with a green shawl around the shoulders. Warm and stylish!

ArmorDress6.name: Blue Dress with Beads
ArmorDress6.desc: A fancy blue dress, with beads and bronze fibula brooches. Excellent for a feast!

ArmorDress7.name: Plain Yellow Dress
ArmorDress7.desc: A plain yellow dress, worn over a green underdress.

ArmorDress8.name: Yellow Dress with Shawl
ArmorDress8.desc: A yellow dress, with a purple shawl around the shoulders. Warm and stylish!

ArmorDress9.name: Yellow Dress with Beads
ArmorDress9.desc: A fancy yellow dress, with beads and silver fibula brooches. Excellent for a feast!

ArmorFenringChest.name: Fenris Coat
ArmorFenringChest.desc: The beast could draw deep breaths, so that its howl could be heard far across the land.

ArmorFenringLegs.name: Fenris Leggings
ArmorFenringLegs.desc: The legs of the beast were lean and strong, so that it could leap great strides.

ArmorFlametalChest.name: Flametal Breastplate
ArmorFlametalChest.desc: This fusion of mysterious flametal and charred bones serves as a protective layer more resilient than anything you could ever find in Midgard.

ArmorFlametalLegs.name: Flametal Greaves
ArmorFlametalLegs.desc: Heavy trousers insulate against the heat, while solid greaves keep your shins safe from low blows.

ArmorGoldHeavyChestUncooked.name: Cast: Breastplate of the Protector
ArmorGoldHeavyChestUncooked.desc: This armour needs to be hardened with frost.

ArmorGoldMageChestUncooked.desc: This armour needs to be hardened with frost.

ArmorGoldMediumLegsUncooked.desc: This armour needs to be hardened with frost.

ArmorHarvester1.name: Harvest Tunic
ArmorHarvester1.desc: When working the fields, it's important to dress accordingly. A shorter tunic lets in a cool breeze.

ArmorHarvester2.name: Harvest Dress
ArmorHarvester2.desc: When working the fields, it's important to dress accordingly. This long dress keeps your knees covered while you work.

ArmorIronChest.name: Iron Scale Mail
ArmorIronChest.desc: An iron scale mail, this will turn all but the strongest of blows.

ArmorIronLegs.name: Iron Greaves
ArmorIronLegs.desc: Iron greaves to protect your legs.

ArmorLeatherChest.name: Leather Tunic
ArmorLeatherChest.desc: A tunic made from animal hide.

ArmorLeatherLegs.name: Leather Trousers
ArmorLeatherLegs.desc: They squeak a little when you walk.

ArmorLoxChest.name: Lox Fur Jacket
ArmorLoxChest.desc: A heavy musk still clings to it.

ArmorMageChest.name: Eitr-weave Robe
ArmorMageChest.desc: These artfully layered robes have spells and charms sewn into every seam and fold.

ArmorMageChest_Ashlands.name: Robes of Embla
ArmorMageChest_Ashlands.desc: Imbued with the power of the first sorceress, these robes will grant a boon to any who seeks to wield the ancient art of magic.

ArmorMageLegs.name: Eitr-weave Trousers
ArmorMageLegs.desc: The trousers worn by mages are always especially tight. Discomfort fuels the focus that is needed for magic...

ArmorMageLegs_Ashlands.name: Trousers of Embla
ArmorMageLegs_Ashlands.desc: Whether or not the first sorceress actually wore trousers exactly like these, we can never know.

ArmorPaddedCuirass.name: Padded Cuirass
ArmorPaddedCuirass.desc: Finely wrought and strong enough to turn even the sharpest blades.

ArmorRootChest.name: Root Harnesk
ArmorRootChest.desc: Finely wrought and strong enough to turn even the sharpest blades.

ArmorRootLegs.name: Root Leggings
ArmorRootLegs.desc: A light armour oddly woven together by ancient roots and bark.

ArmorTrollLeatherChest.name: Troll Leather Tunic
ArmorTrollLeatherChest.desc: Trolls are hard to skin but their leather is tough and warm.

ArmorTunic1.name: Plain Blue Tunic
ArmorTunic1.desc: A plain blue tunic, brightly dyed.

ArmorTunic10.name: Simple Undyed Tunic
ArmorTunic10.desc: A simple tunic for everyday wear.

ArmorTunic2.name: Blue Tunic with Cape
ArmorTunic2.desc: A blue tunic, worn with a fashionable cape made from fine brown wool.

ArmorTunic3.name: Blue Tunic with Beads
ArmorTunic3.desc: A blue tunic worn with beads and silver jewelry. Sure to attract attention from other vikings.

ArmorTunic4.name: Plain Red Tunic
ArmorTunic4.desc: A plain red tunic, brightly dyed.

ArmorTunic5.name: Red Tunic with Cape
ArmorTunic5.desc: A red tunic, worn with a fashionable cape made from fine green wool.

ArmorTunic6.name: Red Tunic with Beads
ArmorTunic6.desc: A red tunic worn with beads and bronze jewelry. Sure to attract attention from other vikings.

ArmorTunic7.name: Plain Yellow Tunic
ArmorTunic7.desc: A plain yellow tunic, brightly dyed.

ArmorTunic8.name: Yellow Tunic with Cape
ArmorTunic8.desc: A yellow tunic, worn with a fashionable cape made from fine purple wool.

ArmorTunic9.name: Yellow Tunic with Beads
ArmorTunic9.desc: A yellow tunic worn with beads and silver jewelry. Sure to attract attention from other vikings.

ArmorWolfChest.name: Wolf Hide Chestpiece
ArmorWolfChest.desc: A wolfskin jerkin, warm and wild-looking. It protects against the cold.

ArrowBloodGold.name: Bloodgold Arrow
ArrowBloodGold.desc: An arrow forged of perhaps the hardest materials in this world...

ArrowBronze.name: Bronzehead Arrow
ArrowBronze.desc: Sharper than flint. A sleek messenger of death.

ArrowCarapace.name: Carapace Arrow
ArrowCarapace.desc: Heavy and pointy, this one's gonna hurt.

ArrowCharred.name: Charred Arrow
ArrowCharred.desc: This arrow has been whittled into shape from a charred femur, and it's as hard as any metal.

ArrowFire.name: Fire Arrow
ArrowFire.desc: This arrow burns whatever it pierces.

ArrowFlint.name: Flinthead Arrow
ArrowFlint.desc: A hide-breaker with a head of flint.

ArrowIron.name: Ironhead Arrow
ArrowIron.desc: Capped with iron and flighted with dark feathers.

ArrowSilver.name: Silver Arrow
ArrowSilver.desc: A needle to calm restless spirits.

AskBladder.name: Asksvin Bladder
AskBladder.desc: An acidic smell still lingers. Prominently.

AskHide.name: Asksvin Hide
AskHide.desc: This sturdy leather is thick, and still warm to the touch.

AsksvinCarrionNeck.name: Asksvin Neck
AsksvinCarrionNeck.desc: A neck in its final stage of life.

AsksvinCarrionPelvic.name: Asksvin Pelvis
AsksvinCarrionPelvic.desc: The pelvic bone of a four legged creature.

AsksvinCarrionRibcage.name: Asksvin Ribcage
AsksvinCarrionRibcage.desc: These ribs have already been stripped clean of any meat.

AsksvinCarrionSkull.name: Asksvin Skull
AsksvinCarrionSkull.desc: A thick skull, with room for a surprisingly large brain.

AsksvinEgg.name: Asksvin Egg
AsksvinEgg.desc: Hard as rock, yet you can sense the presence of something inside. This should be kept warm.

AsksvinMeat.name: Asksvin Tail
AsksvinMeat.desc: Smells a bit smokey, even when raw.

AtgeirBlackmetal.name: Black Metal Atgeir
AtgeirBlackmetal.desc: A vicious hewing-axe of almost unbreakable black metal.

AtgeirGold.name: Nord Atgeir
AtgeirGold.desc: The edge of this weapon is as deadly as it is shiny.

AtgeirGoldUncooked.name: Cast: Nord Atgeir
AtgeirGoldUncooked.desc: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.

AtgeirGold_BloodLightning.name: Thunderblood Atgeir
AtgeirGold_BloodLightning.desc: The heavens shall sound their praise as you make your enemies bleed.

AtgeirGold_FrostFire.name: Frostfire Atgeir
AtgeirGold_FrostFire.desc: Let the flames begin to devour, while the ice claims whatever remains.

AtgeirHimminAfl.name: Himminafl
AtgeirHimminAfl.desc: It might not be a hammer, but Thor himself would still approve of this weapon.

AtgeirWood.name: Wooden Atgeir
AtgeirWood.desc: It might not hurt a lot, but it has reach!

AxeBerzerkr.name: Berserkir Axes
AxeBerzerkr.desc: Let your rage take over and face the slaughter.

AxeBerzerkrBlood.name: Bleeding Berserkir Axes
AxeBerzerkrBlood.desc: The closer you are to death, the harder you are sure to hit.

AxeBerzerkrLightning.name: Thundering Berserkir Axes
AxeBerzerkrLightning.desc: Carnage spreads around you when you wield these axes, such that Thor himself would be proud.

AxeBerzerkrNature.name: Primal Berserkir Axes
AxeBerzerkrNature.desc: Your most primal instincts take over, and the nature around you reaches out to aid you.

AxeBlackMetal.name: Black Metal Axe
AxeBlackMetal.desc: A perfectly balanced axe forged from dark metal with an emerald sheen.

AxeBronze.name: Bronze Axe
AxeBronze.desc: A bright and burnished blade, curved like a smile.

AxeEarly.name: Early Axes
AxeEarly.desc: Mighty weapons from long ago, from a time when the world was still young and incomplete...

AxeGold.name: Nord Axe
AxeGold.desc: A finely detailed axe, for finely cutting down your enemies.

AxeGoldUncooked.name: Cast: Nord Axe
AxeGoldUncooked.desc: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.

AxeGold_BloodLightning.name: Thunderblood Axe
AxeGold_BloodLightning.desc: As this axe cuts through wood and blood alike, a resounding thunderous crack shall be heard throughout the land.

AxeGold_FrostFire.name: Frostfire Axe
AxeGold_FrostFire.desc: Burn it all to the ground, or freeze it in an eternal moment of destruction...

AxeHead1.name: Curious Axe Head
AxeHead1.desc: The metal glints oddly in the sunlight. Somehow, you know that it can never be complete on its own...

AxeHead2.name: Mysterious Axe Head
AxeHead2.desc: What battles has this weapon borne witness to? You cannot see its past, only shape its future...

AxeIron.name: Iron Axe
AxeIron.desc: Sharp and strong, a woodcutter's friend.

AxeJotunBane.name: Jotun Bane
AxeJotunBane.desc: Not even the giants of old could weather the poisonous bite of this weapon.

AxeWood.name: Wooden Axe
AxeWood.desc: If this axe could chop wood, wouldn't that be strange?

BakedPoteitr.name: Baked Poteitr
BakedPoteitr.desc: Neither boiled nor mashed nor in a stew. Still delicious though!

BarberKit.name: Barber Kit
BarberKit.desc: A kit fit for the finest of barbers.

BarkaBranch.name: Frozen Branch
BarkaBranch.desc: This piece of wood was once animated and alive. Still a strange, magical air clings to it.

BarrelRings.name: Barrel Hoops
BarrelRings.desc: These metal rings are perfectly round, suitable for holding a barrel together. Just add wood!

BattleaxeBlackmetal.name: Black Metal Battleaxe
BattleaxeBlackmetal.desc: Green shall be the last thing your foes see before you cleave them in half.

BattleaxeGold.name: Nord Greataxe
BattleaxeGold.desc: A mighty axe fit for a mighty warrior.

BattleaxeGoldUncooked.name: Cast: Nord Greataxe
BattleaxeGoldUncooked.desc: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.

BattleaxeGold_BloodLightning.name: Thunderblood Greataxe
BattleaxeGold_BloodLightning.desc: As you cleave your foes in two, their blood shall sing like a thunderstorm.

BattleaxeGold_FrostFire.name: Frostfire Greataxe
BattleaxeGold_FrostFire.desc: Strike your foes with a frozen inferno!

BattleaxeSkullSplittur.name: Skull Splittur
BattleaxeSkullSplittur.desc: Will find skulls to split even in the thickest of mists.

BattleaxeWood.name: Wooden Battleaxe
BattleaxeWood.desc: Intimidating, but not as intimidating as the real thing.

BeechSeeds.name: Beech Seeds
BeechSeeds.desc: Plant them to grow a beech tree.

Bell.name: Bell
Bell.desc: For whom does the bell toll?

BellFragment.name: Bell Fragment
BellFragment.desc: This ancient fragment appears to be a piece of a broken bell...

Bilebag.name: Bilebag
Bilebag.desc: Caustic bile drawn from the corpse of a gjall.

BirchSeeds.name: Birch Seeds
BirchSeeds.desc: Plant them to grow a birch tree.

BjornHide.name: Bear Hide
BjornHide.desc: A thick and furry hide, coarse yet incredibly soft.

BjornMeat.name: Bear Meat
BjornMeat.desc: This fatty meat was once meant to sustain a body through hibernation.

BjornPaw.name: Bear Paw
BjornPaw.desc: Sharp claws suitable for picking berries – or for dismembering.

BlackCore.name: Black Core
BlackCore.desc: Filled to the brim with ancient power.

BlackMarble.name: Black Marble
BlackMarble.desc: A block of solid stone, seamed with shifting colors.

BlackMetal.name: Black Metal
BlackMetal.desc: A heavy bar of dark metal.

BlackMetalScrap.name: Black Metal Scrap
BlackMetalScrap.desc: A twisted hunk of dark metal.

BlackSoup.name: Black Soup
BlackSoup.desc: A perfect balance of sweetness and acidity.

Blackwood.name: Ashwood
Blackwood.desc: Wood hardened by fire and ash.

BlobVial.name: Corked Vial
BlobVial.desc: Thick enough to contain something volatile, yet fragile enough to be shattered.

BloodGoldKey.name: Intricate Key
BloodGoldKey.desc: If there's a key, then surely there must be a lock.

Bloodbag.name: Bloodbag
Bloodbag.desc: The contents of a leech. Ick!

BoltBlackmetal.name: Black Metal Bolt
BoltBlackmetal.desc: A sleek bolt of dark metal.

BoltBloodGold.name: Bloodgold Bolt
BoltBloodGold.desc: A bolt forged of perhaps the hardest materials in this world...

BoltBone.name: Bone Bolt
BoltBone.desc: A crude bolt of yellowed bone.

BoltCharred.name: Charred Bolt
BoltCharred.desc: A sturdy bone from a forearm, shaped into a deadly bolt.

BombBlob_Frost.name: Blob Bomb: Frost
BombBlob_Frost.desc: If you hold it for too long your hand might just freeze in place.

BombBlob_Lava.name: Blob Bomb: Lava
BombBlob_Lava.desc: The vial is hot in your hand, promising fiery destruction.

BombBlob_Morkhalla.name: Blob Bomb: Pulp
BombBlob_Morkhalla.desc: A dungeon is where the blob is.

BombBlob_Poison.name: Blob Bomb: Poison
BombBlob_Poison.desc: Should this vial break, caution is strongly advised.

BombBlob_PoisonElite.name: Blob Bomb: Elite Poison
BombBlob_PoisonElite.desc: Breathing in the fumes is not recommended.

BombBlob_Tar.name: Blob Bomb: Tar
BombBlob_Tar.desc: The sticky substance within pulses, as if threatening you.

BombDynamite.name: Ember Charge
BombDynamite.desc: Trapped embers, ready to burst. Caution is advised.

BombLava.name: Basalt Bomb
BombLava.desc: With enough heat, it solidifies upon explosion.

BombSiege.name: Explosive Payload
BombSiege.desc: Best used with a catapult. Handle with care.

BombSmoke.name: Smoke Bomb
BombSmoke.desc: Everyone knows you can't breathe in the smoke.

BoneMawSerpentMeat.name: Bonemaw Meat
BoneMawSerpentMeat.desc: A tasty, white fish meat. Very good for your bones!

BonemawSerpentScale.name: Bonemaw Scale
BonemawSerpentScale.desc: It looks just like bone. Best not to question the anatomy of this creature too much...

BonemawSerpentTooth.name: Bonemaw Tooth
BonemawSerpentTooth.desc: This has caused the death of many a brave sailor.

BowAshlands.name: Ash Fang
BowAshlands.desc: Risen again from the ashes, this bow holds unyielding strength.

BowAshlandsBlood.name: Blood Fang
BowAshlandsBlood.desc: Arrows loosed from this bow will tear into flesh with unmatched ferocity.

BowAshlandsRoot.name: Root Fang
BowAshlandsRoot.desc: Like the twisting branch was made to seek the sun, this bow was made to seek the slaughter.

BowAshlandsStorm.name: Storm Fang
BowAshlandsStorm.desc: Let your arrows fly as swift as the lightning strikes.

BowDraugrFang.name: Draugr Fang
BowDraugrFang.desc: Dark wood strung with glistening sinew. A vicious thing.

BowFineWood.name: Finewood Bow
BowFineWood.desc: A simple bow of strong and supple wood.

BowGold.name: Nord Bow
BowGold.desc: This bow shall find its target with a golden precision.

BowGoldUncooked.name: Cast: Nord Bow
BowGoldUncooked.desc: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.

BowGold_BloodLightning.name: Thunderblood Bow
BowGold_BloodLightning.desc: Lightning dances along the string, waiting to be unleashed.

BowGold_FrostFire.name: Frostfire Bow
BowGold_FrostFire.desc: Keep your head cool as you draw, and then let your fury loose with your arrows.

BowHuntsman.name: Huntsman Bow
BowHuntsman.desc: Finely worked and strung. A huntsman's joy.

BowSpineSnap.name: Spinesnap
BowSpineSnap.desc: Using this bow is backbreaking work but so worth it.

Bronze.name: Bronze
Bronze.desc: A strong alloy of copper and tin.

BronzeNails.name: Bronze Nails
BronzeNails.desc: Used in construction of ships and furniture.

BronzeScrap.name: Scrap Bronze
BronzeScrap.desc: It's old and oxidized but can be smelted and used again.

BugMeat.name: Seeker Meat
BugMeat.desc: When you crack open their shells, the meat within is tender and succulent.

CandleWick.name: Candle Wick
CandleWick.desc: Steep these in something flammable for a long lasting and cosy light source.

CapeAsh.name: Ashen Cape
CapeAsh.desc: Thin metal threads are woven into this cape to create an intricate pattern, like a destiny woven by the Norns themselves.

CapeAsksvin.name: Asksvin Cloak
CapeAsksvin.desc: This thick cape catches the wind, not unlike the sail of a ship.

CapeDeepNorth.name: Moose Hide Cape
CapeDeepNorth.desc: A warm cape with fine details of spun gold.

CapeDeepNorthMage.name: Cape of the Caller
CapeDeepNorthMage.desc: A strange magic is woven into this cape, making it both light and warm.

CapeFeather.name: Feather Cape
CapeFeather.desc: Donning this cape makes you feel lighter, almost as if you could fly!

CapeLox.name: Lox Cape
CapeLox.desc: A pelt from one of the great beasts, thick and warm.

CapeOdin.name: Cape of Oden
CapeOdin.desc: Oden's finest warriors deserve the finest cloth.

CapeWolf.name: Wolf Fur Cape
CapeWolf.desc: Wolves are natural survivors. This one was just unlucky. Now its pelt will warm you in the snow.

CarrotSeeds.name: Carrot Seeds
CarrotSeeds.desc: Plant these if you like carrots...

CarrotSoup.name: Carrot Soup
CarrotSoup.desc: A warm tasty soup made of mostly carrots.

Catapult_ammo.name: Grausten Payload
Catapult_ammo.desc: Best used with a catapult. Make sure nothing fragile is in the way.

CelestialFeather.name: Celestial Feather
CelestialFeather.desc: The only remnant of the fallen valkyrie's former self.

CeramicPlate.name: Ceramic Plate
CeramicPlate.desc: No matter how hot this gets, the other side of it remains strangely cool.

CharcoalResin.name: Charcoal Resin
CharcoalResin.desc: The resin from a tree that was set ablaze a long time ago. It's still ready to burn some more.

CharredBone.name: Charred Bone
CharredBone.desc: Followed by the distinct smell of burnt meat.

CharredCogwheel.name: Charred Cogwheel
CharredCogwheel.desc: This could be used for some clever machinery...

Charred_Breastplate.name: Iron plate armor
Charred_Breastplate.desc: An iron scale mail, this will turn all but the strongest of blows.

Charred_Helmet.name: Iron plate armor
Charred_Helmet.desc: An iron scale mail, this will turn all but the strongest of blows.

Charred_HipCloth.name: Iron plate armor
Charred_HipCloth.desc: An iron scale mail, this will turn all but the strongest of blows.

Charred_MageCloths.name: Iron plate armor
Charred_MageCloths.desc: An iron scale mail, this will turn all but the strongest of blows.

Charredskull.name: Charred Skull
Charredskull.desc: The blackened skull of a long-dead warrior. It's unlikely that a proper burial would grant them any peace.

ChickenEgg.name: Egg
ChickenEgg.desc: Keep it warm to see what comes out.. but what came first, really?

ChickenMeat.name: Chicken Meat
ChickenMeat.desc: All chickens bear the ancestral curse of being delicious.

CookedAsksvinMeat.name: Cooked Asksvin Tail
CookedAsksvinMeat.desc: This meat has a potent and mature flavour, but is very tasty when grilled right.

CookedBoneMawSerpentMeat.name: Cooked Bonemaw Meat
CookedBoneMawSerpentMeat.desc: The boiling sea did nothing to this meat, but grilling it over the fire has given it a delightful crisp.

CookedBugMeat.name: Cooked Seeker Meat
CookedBugMeat.desc: Succulent white meat. A true delicacy.

CookedLoxMeat.name: Cooked Lox Meat
CookedLoxMeat.desc: A great hunk of tender meat, food fit for Valhalla!

CookedMooseMeat.name: Cooked Moose Meat
CookedMooseMeat.desc: This meat is lean yet full of flavour.

CookedSealBlubber.name: Cooked Seal Blubber
CookedSealBlubber.desc: A chewy meat, with an aftertaste of remorse.

CookedVoltureMeat.name: Cooked Volture Meat
CookedVoltureMeat.desc: A chewy and somewhat dry meat. Some seasoning would probably make it taste better, but it'll fill your stomach regardless.

Copper.name: Copper
Copper.desc: A bar of pure copper ready to be worked.

CopperOre.name: Copper Ore
CopperOre.desc: Unrefined copper. Needs to be refined in a smelter.

CopperScrap.name: Copper Scrap
CopperScrap.desc: One person's scrap is another person's treasure.

CrossbowGold.name: Nord Crossbow
CrossbowGold.desc: An incredible force is bound to this weapon, waiting to be unleashed.

CrossbowGoldUncooked.name: Cast: Nord Crossbow

FW_ArmorMageLegs.desc: The trousers worn by mages are always especially tight. Discomfort fuels the focus that is needed for magic...

FW_ArmorMageLegs_Ashlands.name: Trousers of Embla
FW_ArmorMageLegs_Ashlands.desc: Whether or not the first sorceress actually wore trousers exactly like these, we can never know.

FW_ArmorPaddedCuirass.name: Padded Cuirass
FW_ArmorPaddedCuirass.desc: Finely wrought and strong enough to turn even the sharpest blades.

FW_ArmorTrollLeatherChest.desc: Trolls are hard to skin but their leather is tough and warm.

FW_AxeBronze.desc: A bright and burnished blade, curved like a smile.

FW_BowDraugrFang.name: Draugr Fang
FW_BowDraugrFang.desc: Dark wood strung with glistening sinew. A vicious thing.

FW_CapeWolf.desc: Wolves are natural survivors. This one was just unlucky. Now its pelt will warm you in the snow.

FW_HelmetBronze.desc: This will help to keep your brains inside your skull.

FW_KnifeSkollAndHati.name: Skoll and Hati
FW_KnifeSkollAndHati.desc: Stab once for those who've betrayed you, and twice for those you hate.

FW_ShieldBlackmetalTower.desc: A tower shield of gleaming dark metal.

FW_StaffFireball.name: Staff of Embers
FW_StaffFireball.desc: The sweltering heat of Muspelheim seems almost pathetic when compared to what this staff can do...

FW_StaffLightning.name: Dundr
FW_StaffLightning.desc: What happens next may shock you.

FW_SwordBlackmetal.name: Black Metal Sword
FW_SwordBlackmetal.desc: A thing of death and beauty. It catches the light with a greenish glow.

FaderDrop.desc: The smouldering remains of a patriarch.

FaderEmber.name: Embers
FaderEmber.desc: Every flying ember is a burning wish to repent.

FeastAshlands_Material.name: Ashlands Gourmet Bowl
FeastAshlands_Material.desc: It's hard to tell whether the steam coming off of this dish is because it's freshly cooked or because of the asksvin meat in it. Either way, the spiced meat together with the vineberries and fiddlehead sprouts is so delicious that it doesn't matter!

FeastBlackforest_Material.name: Black Forest Buffet Platter
FeastBlackforest_Material.desc: You won't be able to resist this platter of delights from the Black Forest! Venison sirloin steaks are served together with spiced thistles and carrots, and the whole meal is tied together with delicious jams. Just have one more bite!

FeastDeepNorth_Material.name: Northern Morning Fare
FeastDeepNorth_Material.desc: Warming and filling, this meal will sustain you even during the coldest of days. Porridge and pancakes pair well with jams and sausages, making it hard not to come back for a second helping!

FeastMeadows_Material.name: Whole Roasted Meadow Boar
FeastMeadows_Material.desc: A boar that has been roasted to perfection, glazed and served atop a bed of greens, with additional cuts of meat on the side. A feast like this is sure to fill your stomach and brighten your day!

FeastMistlands_Material.name: Mushrooms Galore á la Mistlands
FeastMistlands_Material.desc: The time has come for mushroom enthusiasts to rejoice! Try different kinds of mushrooms, mushroom marinated seeker meat and mushroom-filled misthare, and don't miss out on the tasty sap dressing.

FeastMountains_Material.name: Hearty Mountain Logger's Stew
FeastMountains_Material.desc: Gather around this steaming pot full of deliciousness and warm yourselves up again after a day out in the cold. The usually tough and chewey wolf meat has become tender enough to practically melt in your mouth, and the onions and carrots are made even tastier with exciting spices.

FeastOceans_Material.name: Sailor's Bounty
FeastOceans_Material.desc: Fish, fish, and more fish! And also serpent meat, cut to look like fish! Explore the flavours of the Ocean, along with some grilled greens for those still practicing their sea legs.

FeastPlains_Material.name: Plains Pie Picnic
FeastPlains_Material.desc: There's nothing plain about this feast! Enjoy pies and loaves fresh from the oven, both sweet and savoury, and experience the culinary equivalent of a hug.

FeastSwamps_Material.name: Swamp Dweller's Delight
FeastSwamps_Material.desc: Who knew that leeches were edible? With the correct preparation (lots of cooking and lots of seasoning) you will be able to serve them in this feast for the culinary brave. For those who have a sensitive stomach, there are also tasty skewers of sausages and turnips on the side.

Feaster.name: Serving Tray
Feaster.desc:
Set the table with whatever food and drink you fancy, and impress your guests with a delicious feast.

Once a feast has been eaten of, it won't return any resources if dismantled.

FierySvinstew.name: Fiery Svinstew
FierySvinstew.desc: This musty stew is a necessity on every adventurer's menu.

HelmetMidsummerCrown.name: Midsummer Crown

HelmetStrawHat.desc: The perfect way to avoid sunstroke.

SpicePlains.name: Grasslands Herbalist Harvest

SpicyMarmalade.name: Spicy Marmalade
